pyqgis_plugin.name: Geology from points and lines
pyqgis_plugin.description: Automated Geological Mapping Plugin
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin automates the creation of geological polygons by converting linear geological boundaries (contacts) into closed geometries. By leveraging control points that hold the specific geological data, the tool automatically assigns the correct attributes such as lithology and age to the resulting areas. This ensures high geometric accuracy and maintains strict topology between contact lines and geological units.

pyqgis_plugin.name: GeoFlight Planner
pyqgis_plugin.description: A versatile QGIS plugin for drone flight planning, ensuring optimized flight paths and high-quality data capture.
pyqgis_plugin.about: A QGIS plugin for precise drone flight planning, designed for photogrammetry, 3D inspections, and building facade mapping. It includes tools for terrain-following flights, circular paths around structures, and vertical facade mapping, generating CSV files compatible with Litchi or other flight apps and 2 QGIS Layers: Flight Line and Photos Points.
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: Prof Cazaroli, Leandro França, Prof. Ilton Freitas

pyqgis_plugin.name: AfpolGIS Data Connector
pyqgis_plugin.description: This plugin allows you to load geospatial data from several Data Platforms; OnaData, ODK, KoboToolbox, ES World, GTS, DHIS and POLIS.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This software has been developed by the WHO AFRO GIS Team. It is designed to extract, transform and load data from OnaData, ODK, KoboToolbox, ES World, GTS, DHIS and POLIS then adds as a layer on QGIS. It also has the capability of filtering data by date ranges as well as synchronizing real time data from ODK, OnaData and KoboToolbox

pyqgis_plugin.name: TeleProp
pyqgis_plugin.description: Radio Propagation Fieldstrength
pyqgis_plugin.about: Fieldstrength prediction of broadcasting transmitter's.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Seismic microzones with morphological gradient
pyqgis_plugin.description: This DTM-based plugin provides a critical territorial screening tool. By intersecting slope gradients (≥ 15°) with seismic microzonation data, it automatically identifies slopes prone to instability or motion amplification during earthquakes. An indispensable asset for geologists and land-use planners, it allows for rapid risk assessment, streamlined site investigations, and the design of targeted mitigation strategies, significantly reducing operational costs and time.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Seismic zones with morphological gradient (SMG). The morphological gradient in seismic areas with slopes greater than 15° can influence the propagation of seismic waves, amplifying their energy and increasing the risks of ground instability. This plugin identifies areas with a morphological gradient with slopes ≥15° within defined zones (input vector file) starting from the DTM.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Layer Color Plugin
pyqgis_plugin.description: This plugin enables users to customize the background colors of layers and groups in the layer tree view, enhancing visual organization and project management.
pyqgis_plugin.about: It streamlines the organization and management of complex QGIS projects by allowing users to visually distinguish different layers or groups through custom background colors. This plugin adds a menu called "Layer Highlight Color", located above the "Properties" in the "Layer Properties" menu. Always choose pastel or lighter colors. The code implements "WCAG 2.0" contrast ratio checking to avoid colors that can make hard to read the layer text.
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: Renato Henriques - University of Minho; Institute of Earth Sciences

pyqgis_plugin.name: Sankalan 2

pyqgis_plugin.about: To be used in Sankalan 2.0 Mobile Application for transfer of data to and from mobile app. This QGIS Plugin is Designed and Developed by India Institute of Remote Sensing, ISRO Dehradun under AMRUT Phase -2 Programme of Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India, © IIRS, ISRO
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: Indian Institute of Remote Sensing, ISRO

pyqgis_plugin.name: Elasticsearch Loader
pyqgis_plugin.description: Connects to an Elasticsearch index, executes a query, and loads the results as a QGIS layer.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
This plugin allows users to connect to Elasticsearch and query geospatial data to load into QGIS as a layer.
Features: * Dynamic Elasticsearch Connection * Query Execution * QGIS Integration * Log viewer for status and error messages
Find more details here - https://github.com/kapil-grv/qgis-plugins/blob/main/elasticsearch_loader/README.MD

pyqgis_plugin.name: WQICalculator
pyqgis_plugin.description: A QGIS plugin that automatically generates the Water Quality Index (WQI) using raster data.
pyqgis_plugin.about: A QGIS plugin that automatically generates the Water Quality Index (WQI) using raster data of multiple physicochemical parameters. Simplify your analysis and gain valuable insights into water quality of a given zone with just a few clicks.

pyqgis_plugin.name: WMS CQL Filter to QGIS Server Filter Request
pyqgis_plugin.description: Transforms CQL_FILTER WMS request to a QGIS server compatible FILTER request
pyqgis_plugin.about:
QGIS server plugin that intercepts and transforms a CQL_FILTER (Geoserver standard) WMS request to QGIS server-compatible FILTER request, which has a different syntax. See Github for more info.
Icon created by surang - Flaticon

pyqgis_plugin.name: Connector for ODK
pyqgis_plugin.description: Connect to ODK Central, split layers, run QA/QC on File Geodatabases, and upload vector data to KeSMIS — with in-app help on every tool.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Connector for ODK is a four-tool QGIS plugin suite. Get Data downloads ODK Central form submissions as map layers. Split Layer creates separate layers for each unique attribute value. QA/QC runs topology, attribute, and geometry checks on File Geodatabase layers and writes issue layers plus PDF reports. Import uploads vector features to KeSMIS with full settlement sync (field mapping, create/update via upsert), automatic field mapping, dry-run validation, and spatial parent matching.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Layer Reverse
pyqgis_plugin.description: Reverse order of highlighted layers
pyqgis_plugin.about: Reverse order of highlighted layers

pyqgis_plugin.name: Open Google Maps
pyqgis_plugin.description: Opens current map extent in a mapping service of your choice!
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Opens your current map canvas in 6 major web mapping services: Google Maps, Google Earth, Apple Maps, OSM, Bing, and Yandex.
Features: - Simple one-click toolbar buttons. - Accurate zoom and coordinate transformation. - Toggle buttons on/off via "Web > Open Google Maps, Google Earth + Other Web Maps > Configure Maps" menu to keep your interface clean.

pyqgis_plugin.name: GDI
pyqgis_plugin.description: QGIS plugin for discovering and accessing datasets from the GDI platform using Data Explorer, Authorization Server, and OGC Resource Server APIs.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Facilitates discovery and access to datasets available on the GDI platform and allows users to search and load vector and raster datasets directly into QGIS.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Gender Enabling Environments Spatial Tool (GEEST)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Geospatial Enabling Environments for Employment Spatial Tool
pyqgis_plugin.about: The Geospatial Enabling Environments for Employment Spatial Tool, developed by the World Bank, supports the evaluation of locations based on its supportiveness for employment and entrepreneurship. It allows for a generic analysis of foundational infrastructure and mobility aspects but also supports the inclusion of women specific considerations that can act as barriers in their economic empowerment. By analyzing spatial factors across three dimensions (Contextual/ Accessibility and Place Characterization) GeoE3 is a stepping stone to identifying the critical employment investments required in cities and regions.
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: Kartoza for and with The World Bank

pyqgis_plugin.name: EBVCubeVisualizer
pyqgis_plugin.description: Visualize biodiversity-related netCDF data within QGIS.
pyqgis_plugin.about: EBVCubeVisualizer provides an intuitive QGIS interface for exploring and visualizing biodiversity netCDF datasets (EBVCubes). It enables interactive navigation, metadata review, and flexible data selection by scenarios, metrics, entities, and time, supporting effective biodiversity data exploration.
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: Emmanuel Oceguera-Conchas, Luise Quoss, Lina Estupinan Suarez, Miguel Fernandez, Nestor Fernandez, Henrique M. Pereira

pyqgis_plugin.name: MeasureCalculator
pyqgis_plugin.description: QGIS plugin for calculates area, perimeter, and length for selected features with automatic reprojection for accuracy.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Calculates measures for selected features, reprojecting to UTM or Polyconic for precise results. Reports lengths and perimeters in kilometers (km) and areas in hectares (ha) by default, and also displays results in the project's configured measurement units. Optionally updates fields or creates a temporary layer.

pyqgis_plugin.name: IdentifProj
pyqgis_plugin.description: This QGIS plugin is an easy way to guess which map projection has been used for a location.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This QGIS plugin is an easy way to guess which map projection has been used for a location.<br><br>The plugin has 3 use cases :<br>- type projected coordinates and get all thez possible points all over the world<br>- click on a location on the map and find all the possible projected coordinates<br>- draw a bbox and find all the projected bboxes<br><br>With Point2Coord and BBox2Coord, it is possible to filter results by projection type and/or country, area name or country trigram. <br><br>IMPORTANT: at the first start, the plugin will build its CRS database from Qgis CRS list. You will also get minx, miny, maxx, maxy, and extent column conveniently.

pyqgis_plugin.name: QGIS Pip Manager
pyqgis_plugin.description: A QGIS plugin to manage Python packages within the QGIS environment, simplifying installation, uninstallation, searching, and versioning without command-line interaction.
pyqgis_plugin.about: The QGIS Pip Manager plugin provides a user-friendly, tabbed interface for managing Python packages. It features PyPI live search, environment snapshots, preset stacks, requirements.txt import/export, dry-run checks, conflict detection, and automatic Python path detection with cross-platform support.
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: Mohamed Shamroukh, Asya Natapov and Taimaz Larimian

pyqgis_plugin.name: Add BIM Data Dictionary Semantics
pyqgis_plugin.description: Use the buildingSMART Data Dictionary (bSDD) API or similar APIs to classify features and add attributes
pyqgis_plugin.about: The plugin connects to the buildingSMART Data Dictionary (bSDD) API or other similar APIs. The user can search for concepts to annotate features in QGIS layers and add predifined attributes from the data dictionary.

pyqgis_plugin.name: grd2stream
pyqgis_plugin.description: streamline generation from gridded data
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin allows the seamless generation of multiple flowlines (by selecting seed points) from rasters – using Runge-Kutta integration methods. Powered by GMT6, it ensures compatibility with all GDAL file formats!
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: Thomas Kleiner, Abraham Wondimu, Anna Menshikova, Maxim Poliakov, Simon Povh

pyqgis_plugin.name: AutoSave
pyqgis_plugin.description: Automatically saves the QGIS project and editable layers at a user-defined interval.
pyqgis_plugin.about: The Auto Save plugin optimizes your QGIS workflow by periodically saving your project and editing layers. It waits until geometry editing is finalized, and you can enable or disable confirmation prompts before saving.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Geom From Attribute
pyqgis_plugin.description: This plugin allows users to create geometry using attributes from table.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin allows users to create layer (with geometry) using attributes from tables(CSV, excel, parquet etc.). It creates GPKG, SHP, KML, GML or GEOJSON file from QGIS compatible table based layers. There are two options to create geometry. First one is using columns, that contain X(longitude) and Y(latitude) values of Points. This method can be used only for Points. Other option is using single column, that contains Well Known Text(WKT) values of geometry. This method is used for Points, MultiPoints, Lines, MultiLines, Polygons and MultiPolygons. If input table contains WKT values for multiple geometry types (such as Polygon, Point, Line etc.) each type is saved seperately. Sample data and processing steps are available in https://github.com/caliskanmurat/qgis_geom_from_attribute_plugin.

pyqgis_plugin.name: QTempo
pyqgis_plugin.description: Plugin for accessing data from the TEMPO-Online statistical database of the National Institute of Statistics of Romania
pyqgis_plugin.about: QTempo is a QGIS Python plugin that provides an intuitive GUI for querying the TEMPO-Online database and seamlessly adding datasets as separate layers in the software. TEMPO-Online is a statistical database provided by the National Institute of Statistics, offering a wide range of socio-economic indicators. In addition to its online platform, available on the National Institute of Statistics website, the datasets can also be accessed via the TEMPO-Online REST API. This API provides endpoints for both GET requests (retrieving statistical domains, metadata, etc.) and POST requests (querying datasets), with responses formatted in JSON.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Promptly
pyqgis_plugin.description: Execute LLM-generated code for QGIS processing. This plugin provides a simple interface to send prompts to various LLM providers (Ollama, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Anthropic, and custom endpoints) and execute the generated Python code in QGIS. It supports all major platforms (Windows, Linux, macOS) and includes features for database schema integration and layer metadata reference. Requirements: QGIS 3.0 or later, Python 3.x, Python 'requests' library (required for API communication). Installation Instructions: For Windows users - Install requests library using pip in QGIS Python environment (Open OSGeo4W Shell and run: pip install requests). For Linux/macOS users - Install using pip or system package manager.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin provides an interface to send prompts to various LLM providers (Ollama, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Anthropic, and custom endpoints) and execute the generated Python code in QGIS. Features include: Support for multiple LLM providers, Database schema integration for SQL queries, Layer metadata reference for QGIS operations, Code execution with error handling and fixing, Cross-platform compatibility.

pyqgis_plugin.name: QGIS Track Changes
pyqgis_plugin.description: A plugin to track every change of vector data
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin helps track changes in vector layer data, including: - Feature modifications - Geometry updates - Attribute changes It ensures data integrity by logging changes efficiently within QGIS.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Warszawa GIS
pyqgis_plugin.description: Wtyczka zapewniająca łatwy dostęp do danych przestrzennych m.st. Warszawy.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Wtyczka łączy w sobie kilka źródeł danych przestrzennych udostępnianych przez m.st. Warszawę. Zawiera następujące moduły: - zbiór WMS-ów z ortofotomapami, zdjęciami ukośnymi i mapami archiwalnymi - pobieracz danych wektorowych - pobieracz działek ewidencyjnych i budynków oraz odnośnik do serwisu mapowego miasta.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Layer Group Locator Plugin
pyqgis_plugin.description: Registers a locator filter that searches for layer groups by name (case insensitive) and jumps to the group in the layer legend.
pyqgis_plugin.about: The Layer Group Locator Plugin is a QGIS plugin that enhances your workflow by allowing you to quickly search for layer groups within your current project. By using a simple prefix (grp), this plugin integrates with the QGIS locator system to find and highlight any layer group whose name matches your query, making project navigation fast and efficient.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Change GPKG Path
pyqgis_plugin.description: QGIS Plugin to change all GPKG datasources inside a GPKG project
pyqgis_plugin.about: QGIS Plugin to automatically repair GPKG projects

pyqgis_plugin.name: SplashTool Result Loader
pyqgis_plugin.description: Load and symbolize results from a SplashTool output directory
pyqgis_plugin.about: SplashTool creates flow accumulation paths and water depths in sinks during heavy rainfall. This plugin identifies the latest iteration results from a SplashTool output directory and loads the symbolized results in the current project.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Matti
pyqgis_plugin.description: A plugin to estimate soybean maturity
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Matti provides an intuitive method for providing same day estimates of soybean maturity in breeding programs. Matti tracks the average green leaf index (GLI) of each plot during the senescence period. Regression models are used to monitor the senescence curve and provide maturity estimates when GLI values are near or below a user-specified threshold. Maturity estimates are added directly to the attribute table associated with the experiment/field shapefile. A summary graph will be displayed indicating the proportion of plots in each experiment rated as mature. This feature helps breeders better plan for note taking and harvest logistics.
**Important** Matti requires the installation of the piecewise-regression package. See GitHub page for details.
Icon created with BioRender

pyqgis_plugin.name: GSM Cover Builder
pyqgis_plugin.description: GSM Cover Builder allows you to quickly generate coverage plans based on localities and a defined coverage radius
pyqgis_plugin.about: The GSM Cover Builder plugin for QGIS is designed to help geomarketing professionals optimize GSM network coverage in specific areas. Using this tool, you can analyze and visualize proximity relationships between localities and determine the minimum number of GSM sites necessary to effectively cover a set of areas.

pyqgis_plugin.name: AzimuthTool
pyqgis_plugin.description: A powerful QGIS plugin for generating vector line layers from azimuths or quadrant bearings and distances, starting from a user-defined point.
pyqgis_plugin.about: AzimuthTool simplifies the creation of line geometries in QGIS by allowing users to input an initial coordinate, followed by angles (azimuths like "90-30-15.50" or bearings like "45-15-30-NE") and distances (e.g., "100.25"). It supports flexible workflows with features like snapping to existing layers, importing/exporting data via text files, and outputting results as shapefiles, geopackages, or temporary layers.

pyqgis_plugin.name: FUN REPROJECTOR
pyqgis_plugin.description: Reproject vector layers by selecting anthropomorphized characters as coordinate systems. Enjoy transforming your layers with a fun and intuitive graphical interface!
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin allows users to reproject vector layers by selecting anthropomorphized mascots representing coordinate reference systems. It provides a fun and intuitive graphical interface to make coordinate transformations an enjoyable experience.

pyqgis_plugin.name: FPT Plot Allocation
pyqgis_plugin.description: Plot allocation for forest inventory
pyqgis_plugin.about: In this module, you will be able to plan forest inventories by allocating plots. All required libraries (NumPy, SciPy, GeoPandas, Shapely) are bundled with the QGIS installation and do not require manual setup.

pyqgis_plugin.name: ČHMÚ/CHMI – Meteorological Data Processing
pyqgis_plugin.description: Weather measurements and spatial interpolation.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This tool processes weather measurements from the Czech Hydrometeorological Institute using spatial interpolation methods. For proper functionality, it requires specially formatted files, which can be downloaded via the link in the plugin.

pyqgis_plugin.name: SpaceMouse3Dconnexion
pyqgis_plugin.description: Plugin Direct HID support for 3DConnexion SpaceMouse in QGIS 3D views
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin enables direct HID communication with 3DConnexion SpaceMouse devices for navigating QGIS 3D views. No additional drivers required. Features include: * Direct HID device communication * 6 degrees of freedom navigation * Customizable sensitivity settings * Kalman filtering for smooth movement * Multiple 3D view support

pyqgis_plugin.name: MapHub
pyqgis_plugin.description: QGIS plugin for uploading, sharing, and managing geospatial data with the MapHub.co platform
pyqgis_plugin.about: MapHub.co is a community hub for GIS users to host, visualize, and share geospatial datasets. This plugin enables seamless integration between QGIS and MapHub.co, allowing users to upload maps to MapHub.co projects, share them publicly or privately, and browse projects and download maps directly within QGIS.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Subsea Cable Tools
pyqgis_plugin.description: Tools to support working with subsea cable data in QGIS.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Subsea Cable Tools is a QGIS Processing Plugin developed to support working with subsea cable data in QGIS.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Create Grids Angle
pyqgis_plugin.description: Create grids under specific angle
pyqgis_plugin.about:
This plugin was developed for creating grids under specific angle based on desired field edge. Creating site-specific units for managing site-specific units within Precision Agriculture concept.
Minimal data set for testing the plugin can be found in GitHub repository, which is a homepage of this plugin.
At the same GitHub repository in the pdf document GuideToUser detailed description of specific options of the plugin can be found!

pyqgis_plugin.name: Carroyage
pyqgis_plugin.description: Generate automatically grids
pyqgis_plugin.about:
This QGIS plugin allows you to generate automatically grids on a map. Each tile generated is a polygon with attributes automatically set allowing easy assignment of labels or spatial queries.
This plugin differs from the classic grid generation by simplifying the orientation of the grid and generating the corresponding attributes.

pyqgis_plugin.name: QGIS-FME Form Connector
pyqgis_plugin.description: The QGIS-FME Form Connector plugin is a powerful tool that bridges QGIS and FME, enabling seamless data transformation and workflow automation between these two platforms.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin enables QGIS users to leverage FME's robust and powerful data transformation capabilities directly within the QGIS interface. To use this plugin, users must ensure that FME Form is installed and licensed. It includes a default FME workspace (template) to help you get started, which can be customized according to your needs. The workspace template (.fmw) can be obtained or downloaded from <a href="https://github.com/gisinnovationmy/QGISFMEFormConnector/blob/main/Version/4.0.0/sampleworkspace/QGISFMEFormConnectorTemplate.fmw">GitHub</a>.

pyqgis_plugin.description: The QGIS-FME Form Connector Algorithm plugin is a powerful tool that bridges QGIS and FME, enabling seamless data transformation and workflow automation between these two platforms.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin enables QGIS users to leverage FME's robust and powerful data transformation capabilities directly within the QGIS interface. The template can be customized to the users needs. The workspace template (.fmw) can be obtained or downloaded from <a href="https://github.com/gisinnovationmy/QGISFMEFormAlgorithm/blob/main/Version/4.0.0/FME Workspace">GitHub</a>.

pyqgis_plugin.name: SegMap

pyqgis_plugin.about: SegMap using deep learning to extract vector features from imagery with just a few clicks, reducing traditional digitization effort by 90%. Ideal for rapid land cover mapping and environmental analysis.

pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin allows users to fetch openly available occurrence data from the FinBIF API (api.laji.fi) and load it directly into QGIS. It provides a user-friendly interface to query the FinBIF API and get the data on a map.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Spatial Statistics
pyqgis_plugin.description: This plugin provide spatial statistic tool
pyqgis_plugin.about: Queen型 / Rook型 の隣接関係、距離ベース（D-near Neighbors）、k近傍（K-nearest neighbors）に基づく 近接行列（Spatial Weight Matrix） を生成できるプラグインです。また、空間自己相関統計量（GISA、LISA）の計算にも対応しています。本プラグインは、内部的に Rスクリプトと spdep パッケージ等を用いて処理を行っています。 事前にRのインストールとQGIS上でのRのパスの設定が必要になります。

pyqgis_plugin.name: Google Maps LocationSync
pyqgis_plugin.description: This plugin enables users to use Google Maps within the QGIS environment, and to synchronize the location on the map.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin enables users to use Google Maps within the QGIS environment, and to synchronize the location on the map.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Rockyfor3D Input Rasters
pyqgis_plugin.description: This plugin prepares the input rasters for the Rockyfor3D rockfall simulation model.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Based on a digital elevation model (DEM) and a polygon or line input (terrain / forest / rockfall nets), the algorithm rasterizes the attributes from the vector layer, ensuring alignment of all output rasters with the DEM grid, and the correct output format of all data (ASCII grid). The tool includes internal checks for invalid or missing geometries, mismatched coordinate reference systems (CRS), and missing values. In addition, attributes are validated against predefined type and value constraints that reflect the expectations of the Rockyfor3D model.

pyqgis_plugin.name: WindScout Basedata Service DEV
pyqgis_plugin.description: Serves base data layers relevant for the renewable energy industry
pyqgis_plugin.about: WindScout Basedata Service serves base data layers relevant for the renewable energy industry. It needs a paid subscription to work.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Layer Name Replacer
pyqgis_plugin.description: A plugin to batch rename layer names based on a text file of replacement rules.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin reads a comma-separated replacement rules file (old,new) and performs batch renaming of all layer names accordingly. By specifying a replacement file, you can efficiently and flexibly organize layer names.

pyqgis_plugin.name: EasyFillet
pyqgis_plugin.description: EasyFillet is a CAD-like fillet tool for QGIS, allowing you to create true tangent arcs and trimmed lines between two segments. The plugin belongs to the PlanX suite.
pyqgis_plugin.about: EasyFillet lets you pick two line segments, preview a radius, and instantly generate a precise tangent arc while trimming the originals so they meet at a perfect node. It streamlines drafting-grade editing inside QGIS and supports PlanX's broader urban-planning tool-chain. Developed with feedback from educational workflows at Dokuz Eylul University, Department of City and Regional Planning.

pyqgis_plugin.name: FaultBufferTool
pyqgis_plugin.description: Create buffers for fault traces based on confidence attributes and ranking criteria.
pyqgis_plugin.about: The Fault Buffer Tool allows geologists and engineers to create uncertainty buffers around mapped fault traces based on literature-backed values. The tool supports multiple uncertainty calculation approaches: general uncertainty, uncertainty with ranking (based on confidence, primary/secondary classification, and simple/complex classification), and geologic judgment. It also handles different fault types (strike-slip, normal, reverse) with appropriate symmetric or asymmetric buffers. Developed at Arizona State University.

pyqgis_plugin.name: GeoBioTool
pyqgis_plugin.description: GeoBioTool(GBT) enables QGIS users to compute biodiversity and canopy structure metrics from classified rasters and ASCII point cloud data. It calculates Shannon–Wiener (Shannon, 1948) and Simpson (Simpson, 1949) indices from land cover classifications, Local Beta diversity (Jaccard / Sorensen) as a window-based turnover summary (TXT report), Foliage Height Diversity (FHD) (MacArthur & MacArthur, 1961), Rumple Index (Parker et al., 2004), Rugosity Index (Dustan et al., 2013), Leaf Area Index (LAI) & Vertical Complexity Index (VCI), and Height-Matrix metrics (zmean, zmax, zmin) from point files. Suitable for biodiversity assessment, ecological monitoring, nature-positive planning, and vertical vegetation analysis.
pyqgis_plugin.about: GeoBioTool(GBT) is a biodiversity analysis plugin powered by Invalab. Vision: Adding Nature, Realizing Nature-Positive. Mission: Re-building nature capital from intangible value into investable asset. We're unlocking the hidden value 'X' from life of earth. Now with Local Beta (Jaccard/Sorensen) in addition to diversity indices, FHD, Rumple, Rugosity, LAI/VCI and Height-Matrix analysis. The plugin menu groups ASCII-report tools and raster-output tools with a visual separator for clarity.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Zonal Line Length
pyqgis_plugin.description: This plugin calculates line lengths within polygons.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin accurately calculates the length of lines contained within each polygon. The calculated distance depends on the coordinate reference system (CRS) of the input layer. To get accurate distances, it is recommended to use a projected coordinate system in meters.<br>Even if a line spans multiple polygons, the line is split at the polygon boundaries so that the length is not calculated twice. However, if the line completely coincides with the polygon boundary (for example, if it overlaps exactly along the boundary), the line may not be processed correctly. This is due to the specifications of the geometry intersection test and split processing.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Atlas-Gittergenerator
pyqgis_plugin.description: Creates regular grids for atlas layouts based on scale and layout format. Optionally, grids can be generated only for selected features.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Atlas Grid Generator is a QGIS plugin designed to create regular grid layers for atlas-based map production. It allows users to generate grids based on map scale and layout format, ensuring consistent and precise coverage.
The plugin supports both full-layer processing and grid creation limited to selected features. It automatically handles geographic (non-metric) coordinate systems by applying an appropriate projected CRS during processing and returning results in the original CRS.
Key features: - Grid generation based on map scale and layout size - Optional processing of selected features only - Automatic CRS handling for non-metric layers - Support for multiple paper formats and custom dimensions - Multi-language user interface (English / German)
---
Der Atlas-Gittergenerator ist ein QGIS-Plugin zur Erstellung regelmäßiger Gitter für Atlas-basierte Kartenproduktionen. Es ermöglicht die Generierung von Gittern basierend auf Maßstab und Layoutformat und sorgt für eine konsistente und präzise Abdeckung.
Das Plugin unterstützt sowohl die Verarbeitung ganzer Layer als auch die Erstellung von Gittern nur für ausgewählte Objekte. Geografische (nicht-metrische) Koordinatensysteme werden automatisch in ein geeignetes projiziertes CRS umgewandelt und anschließend wieder zurücktransformiert.
Hauptfunktionen: - Gittererstellung basierend auf Maßstab und Layoutgröße - Optionale Verarbeitung nur ausgewählter Objekte - Automatische CRS-Behandlung für nicht-metrische Layer - Unterstützung verschiedener Papierformate und benutzerdefinierter Größen - Mehrsprachige Benutzeroberfläche (Englisch / Deutsch)

pyqgis_plugin.name: Polygon Compare
pyqgis_plugin.description: Compares two polygon layers to find added, deleted and modified polygons by unique ID and geometry
pyqgis_plugin.about: The Polygon Compare plugin is a robust tool for QGIS users to analyze changes between two vector polygon layers. By comparing a unique ID field and polygon geometries, it identifies added polygons (new features in the second layer), deleted polygons (features absent in the second layer), and modified polygons (features with the same ID but changed geometry). The plugin outputs three separate layers for easy visualization and analysis, making it invaluable for tasks like land use change detection, parcel compare, footprint compare, urban planning, environmental monitoring, or any GIS workflow tracking spatial updates. With error handling for invalid geometries and detailed processing feedback, Polygon Compare ensures reliable results. Simplify your change detection tasks with this intuitive and efficient plugin, designed to enhance spatial data analysis in QGIS.

pyqgis_plugin.name: QGIS2Mapbender
pyqgis_plugin.description: QGIS plugin to populate Mapbender with WMS services from QGIS Server.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
This QGIS plugin exports your project as a QGIS Server WMS (Web Map Service) and publishes it in a Mapbender application (https://mapbender.org). System Requirements:
- Please note that QGIS2Mapbender version >= 1.0.0 needs Mapbender version >= 4.1.2.
Local requirements - (1) The QGIS project must be saved in the same folder as the data.
Server requirements - (1) QGIS Server and Mapbender must be installed on your server. - (2) Check the Apache and PHP settings in the README file - (3) Define the Mapbender upload directory api_upload_dir - (4) Create at least one template application in Mapbender for cloning and publishing a new WMS or an application for publishing a new WMS. These applications should include a layerset named "main" (default layerset for new WMS) or a custom named layerset (name can be specified in the plugin). - (4) User/Groups: All Mapbender users that should be authorized to use QGIS2Mapbender need special rights.
You find a detailed documentation at https://github.com/WhereGroup/QGIS2Mapbender/blob/main/README.md
Docker: QGIS Server and Mapbender can be run as Docker containers.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Table Structure Compare
pyqgis_plugin.description: Compares the attribute table structures of two vector layers in QGIS, highlighting differences in field names, types, and lengths, with results shown as a temporary layer or a confirmation popup if identical
pyqgis_plugin.about: The Table Structure Compare plugin enables QGIS users to analyze and compare the attribute table structures of two vector layers. Users select a base layer (template) and a layer to compare, and the plugin evaluates differences in field names (case-sensitive and case-insensitive), data types, and field lengths. If the structures are identical, a popup message confirms the match. If differences exist, the plugin generates a temporary memory layer detailing each discrepancy, including missing fields, type mismatches, case-sensitive name differences, and length variations. The output layer is automatically added to the QGIS project, with its attribute table displayed for easy review. Ideal for data validation and ensuring consistency in vector layer schemas, this plugin streamlines the process of identifying structural variations in attribute tables.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Attribute Transfer to Schema
pyqgis_plugin.description: Attribute Transfer to Schema plugin that enables seamless transfer of attribute data from a source vector layer to a template layer with a predefined schema. It features a user-friendly interface with dropdown lists to manually map fields
pyqgis_plugin.about: The Attribute Transfer to Schema plugin for QGIS simplifies the process of transferring attribute data between vector layers with differing schemas. Designed for users working with a template layer (e.g., with fields like ID, Name, Address, UID, Area, Length, Date) and a source layer with potentially different field names, types, or counts (e.g., ID, Nme, Addr, UUID, Shape_Area, Shape_Length, Remark, Others, Date), this plugin ensures precise data transfer. Key features include: Interactive Field Mapping: A intuitive GUI with two dropdown lists allows users to manually map fields from the source layer to the template layer, ensuring only desired attributes are transferred. Schema Preservation: Unmatched fields in the template layer remain blank, maintaining the integrity of the predefined schema. Flexible Workflow: Supports copying features and selectively transferring attribute values based on user-defined mappings.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Sentinel-2 Analyzer
pyqgis_plugin.description: The plugin allows for managing Sentinel-2 data; computing multispectral indices; and performing some analysis.
pyqgis_plugin.about: The S2A plugin is designed to efficiently support the exploration and analysis of Sentinel-2 satellite imagery, with the flexibility to work with other multispectral datasets at different spatial resolutions. <br><br> The plugin enables efficient data management by allowing users to generate image stacks containing only the selected bands. Stack generation can be performed in three ways: directly from a SAFE folder, from a multiband raster, or from individual single-band rasters. <br> S2A also enables the computation of multispectral indices. Several commonly used indices are included by default, and if a specific index is missing, it can be defined and calculated using the built-in calculator. <br> Additional features include mask generation and application, discretization of continuous rasters, basic statistical analysis with automated report generation, and change detection between data acquired at different times.

pyqgis_plugin.name: VertexDistanceChecker
pyqgis_plugin.description: Flags line segments shorter than a defined threshold.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
VertexDistanceChecker is a QGIS plugin designed to detect unusually short segments between consecutive vertices in line geometries. These short segments often indicate oversampled geometry, digitization noise, or potential data quality issues.
Users can define a minimum allowed segment length, and the plugin will flag all cases where the distance between two vertices falls below that threshold. Results are displayed in an interactive dock with zoom-to-feature functionality, and can optionally be exported as a point shapefile marking the midpoint of flagged segments.
The plugin supports both full-layer checks and selected-feature-only analysis.

Supports any geometry type and a variety of matching options including intersects, contains, within, touches, equals, and exact vertex match.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Script Manager
pyqgis_plugin.description: A PyQGIS script manager for safe execution, debugging, and automation. Features a visual browser with an integrated output console, automatic file monitoring, script validation, and full Qt5/Qt6 support.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Script Manager provides a environment for managing, executing, and debugging PyQGIS scripts. Its core features include: a visual script browser with an integrated console to capture print() statements and errors in real-time; a safe execution environment that prevents script failures from crashing QGIS; pre-execution validation to warn against risky code; automatic file monitoring for instant reloading; and a quick access menu for routine tasks. With full Qt5/Qt6 compatibility and multi-language support (EN, PT-BR), it streamlines the development workflow for GIS professionals and developers.

pyqgis_plugin.about: AGLgis is a graphical interface for Sentinel-1 SAR Backscatter Analysis-Ready-Data preparation in Google Earth Engine, inside QGIS. pyqgis_plugin.name: XYZ/MGRS Coordinate Tool
pyqgis_plugin.description: Advanced multi-format coordinate tool supporting XYZ tiles, MGRS, WKT, WKB, and GeoJSON with interactive navigation and visualization. Part of MAS Raster Processing tools.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Professional multi-format coordinate capture and visualization tool for QGIS. Supports 5 coordinate systems with full navigation and plotting capabilities. . SUPPORTED FORMATS: - XYZ Tiles: Web mapping tile coordinates with zoom levels (Red visualization) - MGRS: Military Grid Reference System, Sentinel-2 compatible (Blue visualization) - WKT: Well-Known Text geometry format (Green visualization) - WKB: Well-Known Binary geometry as hex string (Yellow visualization) - GeoJSON: JSON-based geometry format (Purple visualization) . KEY FEATURES: - Interactive map clicking with crosshair cursor for coordinate capture - Dual-mode operation: Click-to-capture OR manual input for all formats - Go To button: Navigate/zoom to any coordinate system location - Plot Polygon/Geometry button: Visualize geometries with color-coded layers - Editable coordinate inputs (X, Y, Z for tiles; text input for others) - Smart geometry type detection (Point, LineString, Polygon, Multi types) - Dockable widget interface with system dropdown selector - Seamless integration with MAS Raster Processing toolbar - Coordinate reprojection support for different CRS - Memory layer creation with proper attribute tables and symbology . QUICK START GUIDE: 1. Activate tool: Click XYZ Coordinate Tool icon or Raster menu - MAS Raster Processing - XYZ Coordinate Tool 2. Select coordinate system from dropdown (XYZ Tiles, MGRS, WKT, WKB, or GeoJSON/JSON) 3. FOR XYZ/MGRS: Click on map to capture coordinates. FOR WKT/WKB/GEOJSON: Paste or type geometry string in the input field 4. Click Go To to navigate to the location 5. Click Plot Polygon to visualize the geometry on map 6. Edit coordinates manually if needed (all inputs are editable) . USE CASES: - Tile-based web mapping applications (XYZ tiles) - Sentinel-2 satellite imagery tile identification (MGRS) - Geometry data exchange and validation (WKT, WKB, GeoJSON) - Coordinate reference system testing and debugging - Geospatial data quality assurance workflows - Educational tool for understanding different coordinate formats . TECHNICAL NOTES: - XYZ tiles: Z value (zoom level) range 0-22, default 14 - MGRS: Fixed latitude band calculation with 2,000,000m cycle handling - WKT/WKB/GeoJSON: Automatic geometry type detection and appropriate symbology - All geometries are created in EPSG:4326 (WGS84) coordinate system - Color-coded layers for easy identification of coordinate system source . Please rate this plugin based on your experience - your feedback motivates continued development! For support, feature requests, or custom QGIS tools: mastools.help@gmail.com MAS = Mirjan Ali Sha (plugin author)

It automates the workflow by validating and preparing input data, generating optimized Survey2GIS commands, executing transformations, and seamlessly importing the results into QGIS via GeoPackage format. Ideal for archaeologists and surveyors working with field data.
pyqgis_plugin.author_name: Landesamt für Denkmalpflege im Regierungspräsidium Stuttgart; CSGIS gbr.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Downscale Anything with Random Forest
pyqgis_plugin.description: Downscale Anything with Random Forest is a QGIS Processing plugin that allows flexible dasymetric downscaling of coarse rasters to user-defined resolutions. The algorithm uses high-resolution covariates and Random Forest regression to redistribute values. Key features include: 1. User-defined target resolution. 2. Random Forest regression with fast pixel sampling. 3. Support for random or spatial-block splitting. 4. Evaluation metrics (R², RMSE, MAE) and OOB score. 5. Outputs raster, CSV (evaluation + feature importance), and PNG plots.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin provides a practical way to perform machine-learning-based downscaling in QGIS. It is suitable for spatial analysis, environmental modeling, and urban/regional studies. Example use cases include downscaling VIIRS Nighttime Lights (avg_rad), Land Surface Temperature (LST), population density (e.g., WorldPop), and other gridded indicators (e.g., PM2.5, precipitation, socio-economic indices). Created by Firman Afrianto.

MVF v3 packages contain indoor mapping data including floor plans, points of interest, and venue metadata. The plugin requires the 'requests' Python library for API functionality, which is typically included with QGIS installations. The Mappedin name and logo (logowhite.png) are trademarks of Mappedin and are included solely for use within this plugin; they are not licensed for reuse, redistribution, or modification outside this plugin.

pyqgis_plugin.description: Opens Google Maps in a dockable panel centered at clicked map locations. Allows seamless switching between Map View and Street View for detailed digitization using high-resolution imagery.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
GoogleMapsStreetDock is a QGIS plugin that integrates Google Maps and Street View into a dockable browser panel. By clicking on the QGIS map canvas, users instantly center the view on the clicked location with coordinates automatically transformed to WGS84 (EPSG:4326). The plugin supports toggling between Map View and Street View within the panel, facilitating precise road network digitization and feature verification using real-world imagery directly inside QGIS.
-Needs PyQtWebEngine -See README (https://github.com/Consortis-Geospatial/GoogleMapsStreetDock) for installation help.

pyqgis_plugin.name: ImageLoader
pyqgis_plugin.description: Click a polygon grid cell to automatically load the corresponding raster image from a selected folder. Optionally set filename prefix and suffix.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
ImageLoader is a QGIS plugin that allows users to click on polygons (e.g., grid tiles) to automatically load and display associated raster images from a local folder.
The plugin supports customizable filename patterns using prefixes and suffixes, and provides an interactive interface for selecting the input layer, field, and image directory.

pyqgis_plugin.name: MunicipalityUnitsUnsnappedLines
pyqgis_plugin.description: Detects road network lines that do not anchor properly at municipal boundaries.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
MunicipalityUnitsUnsnappedLines is a QGIS plugin that identifies road network line features (multiline geometries) whose start or end points do not properly intersect municipal boundary polygons within a user-defined distance threshold.
This helps reveal topological issues or missing connections between networks and administrative borders—especially useful when integrating road datasets from different sources.
Users can specify a maximum snapping distance (in meters), choose to run the check on full layers or only on selected features, and inspect flagged line endpoints in an interactive dock. Results can be exported to a point shapefile for further correction or review.

pyqgis_plugin.name: UnsnappedVerticesChecker
pyqgis_plugin.description: Identifies nearby unconnected vertices between different line features.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
UnsnappedVerticesChecker is a QGIS plugin designed to detect vertices that are spatially close to each other but belong to different line features and are not snapped together. These unsnapped connections may indicate topological errors, such as road segments that appear connected but aren't.
Users can define a proximity threshold in meters. The plugin will analyze the vertices in the active line layer and report cases where different features have vertices that are closer than the threshold but are not connected. The results are displayed in an interactive dock with zoom-to-feature functionality and can be exported as a point shapefile marking the midpoints of flagged pairs.
The plugin supports both full-layer scans and selected-feature-only analysis.

pyqgis_plugin.name: DisconnectedRoadChecker
pyqgis_plugin.description: Identifies short, disconnected road segments - commonly referred to as disconnected islands - that are not properly connected to the rest of the road network. Checks if segment endpoints lack nearby connections within a 0.5 meter buffer to detect topological errors or incomplete digitizations.
pyqgis_plugin.about: DisconnectedRoadChecker is a QGIS plugin designed to flag short road segments isolated from the main network. It analyzes line geometries and checks if segment endpoints connect to other features within a 0.5 meter proximity. Users can define a maximum allowed segment length (meters). Results appear in an interactive dock with zoom and selection options.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Sentinel 1 Image Downloader
pyqgis_plugin.description: This plugin allows users to download Sentinel-1 images.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin allows users to download Sentinel-1 images from Copernicus Data Space platform (https://dataspace.copernicus.eu). Images can be downloaded as zip files. Another option is to download only "quicklook" image (RGB image with lower resolution and size) instead of original Sentinel-1 data. Analysis consists of three processes. "Download Footprints", "Download Images" and "Select Images". In "Download Footprints" section footprints of the images are retrieved based on given conditions (such as date, query area etc.) In "Download Images" section credentials are provided and images are downloaded. "Select Images" section is optional. In this section; footprints can be filtered using quicklook file and saved as new geopackage file.

pyqgis_plugin.name: JVF DTM Plugin

pyqgis_plugin.about: Loads JVF DTM files into QGIS and organizes features into layer groups. Each layer is automatically styled using predefined symbology. Files are processed in the background to keep QGIS responsive during loading. Načítá soubory digitální technické mapy (DTM) ve formátu JVF do QGISu a organizuje prvky do skupin vrstev. Každé vrstvě je automaticky přiřazen předdefinovaný styl. Načítání probíhá na pozadí, takže QGIS zůstává během procesu plně responzivní.

pyqgis_plugin.about: ClimaPlots turns NASA POWER and Open-Meteo (ERA5) daily climate data into trends, indices and thermo-pluviometric diagrams for any point on Earth, directly in QGIS: annual trends with Mann-Kendall and Pettitt tests, ETCCDI indices, SPI, reference ET0, growing degree days and wind. No Google Earth Engine sign-in required. / O ClimaPlots transforma dados climáticos diários da NASA POWER e do Open-Meteo (ERA5) em tendências, índices e diagramas termopluviométricos para qualquer ponto da Terra, diretamente no QGIS: tendências anuais com testes de Mann-Kendall e Pettitt, índices ETCCDI, SPI, ET0 de referência, graus-dia e vento. pyqgis_plugin.name: Ordered files copy
pyqgis_plugin.description: Средство копирования файлов по ссылкам в атрибутах слоя | Tool for copying files by links in layer attributes
pyqgis_plugin.about: Этот инструмент копирует файлы, ссылки на которые содержатся в атрибутах объектов слоя, с возможностью иерархичной группировки файлов в соответствии с другими атрибутами объектов слоя. Допустимо использование в отношении объектов слоя, для которых последовательно через разделитель указаны пути для нескольких файлов (без дополнительных знаков выделения, например кавычек). Инструмент имеет графический интерфейс выбора поля атрибутов, содержащего ссылку; интерфейс ввода используемого разделителя, а также интерфейс выбора типа копирования файлов: с иерархичной группировкой или без таковой. В случае группировки активизируется интерфейс создания иерархичной структуры путем выбора полей атрибутов слоя с учетом последовательности их перечисления.| This tool copies files referenced in layer object attributes, with the option to group files hierarchically according to other layer object attributes. It can be used for layer objects for which paths to multiple files are specified sequentially using a separator (without additional delimiters, such as quotation marks). The tool has a graphical interface for selecting the attribute field containing the link, an interface for entering the separator used, and an interface for selecting the type of file copying: with or without hierarchical grouping. In the case of grouping, the interface for creating a hierarchical structure is activated by selecting layer attribute fields, taking into account the sequence in which they are listed.

pyqgis_plugin.name: AutoOD & AgentSim from WorldPop
pyqgis_plugin.description: AutoOD & AgentSim from WorldPop is a QGIS plugin that automatically builds Origin–Destination (OD) matrices and simulates individual trips (agents) using WorldPop population data and optional POI-based destination attractiveness. Key features include: 1. Zone grid creation from boundary with WorldPop population aggregation. 2. Gravity-based OD matrix with exponential or power distance decay. 3. Optional gravity constraints: unconstrained, origin-constrained, destination-constrained, and doubly constrained (IPF/Furness). 4. Destination attractiveness modelling using population and POI intensity. 5. Agent-based trip sampling with optional animated GIF and static trail visualization. 6. Post-processing including generation/attraction analysis, main route extraction, and DBSCAN clustering.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin bridges population data and mobility simulation for urban and regional planning. It enables planners and researchers to model spatial interaction, explore trip generation and attraction patterns, identify dominant mobility corridors, and communicate results through OD lines, clusters, static maps, and animated GIFs.

This allows you to mosaic together features from different source layers into a single dataset.

pyqgis_plugin.name: istat_confini_plugin
pyqgis_plugin.description: Plugin per scaricare confini amministrativi ISTAT e griglia di popolazione 2021 su standard europeo
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Questo plugin permette di scaricare direttamente i confini amministrativi italiani dal sito ISTAT e la griglia di popolazione 2021 su standard europeo (Eurostat). Supporta regioni, province, comuni e ripartizioni geografiche sia in versione generalizzata che non generalizzata. Include anche la griglia di popolazione del Censimento 2021 con 13 variabili censuarie secondo il Regolamento UE 1799/2018. I dati sono disponibili dal 2022 al 2026 e vengono scaricati direttamente dai server ISTAT. EN:This plugin allows direct download of Italian administrative boundaries from the ISTAT website and the 2021 population grid on European standard (Eurostat). It supports regions, provinces, municipalities and geographical divisions in both generalized and non-generalized versions. It also includes the 2021 Census population grid with 13 census variables according to EU Regulation 1799/2018. Data is available from 2022 to 2026 and downloaded directly from ISTAT servers.
Funzionalità principali: - Download automatico dei file ZIP da ISTAT - Selezione tra 4 tipi di confini amministrativi - Griglia di popolazione 2021 (celle 1 km², EPSG:3035) - Download multipli simultanei (confini + griglia) - Opzione per versione generalizzata o dettagliata - Interfaccia con 3 tab organizzati - Caricamento automatico in QGIS - Interfaccia completamente in italiano - Barra di progresso durante il download - Gestione errori integrata - Possibilità di scaricare solo griglia popolazione
Main features: - Automatic download of ZIP files from ISTAT - Selection between 4 types of administrative boundaries - 2021 population grid (1 km² cells, EPSG:3035) - Simultaneous multiple downloads (boundaries + grid) - Option for generalized or detailed version - Interface with 3 organized tabs - Automatic loading in QGIS - Fully Italian interface - Progress bar during download - Integrated error handling - Option to download only population grid
Requirements: Internet connection for downloading data from ISTAT servers. The plugin uses QGIS native network manager (QgsNetworkAccessManager) which respects proxy settings and provides better integration with QGIS environment. No external dependencies required - works with standard QGIS installation. IT: Requisiti: Connessione internet per scaricare i dati dai server ISTAT. Il plugin usa il gestore di rete nativo di QGIS (QgsNetworkAccessManager) che rispetta le impostazioni proxy e offre migliore integrazione con l'ambiente QGIS. Nessuna dipendenza esterna richiesta - funziona con installazione standard di QGIS.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Radiance2Carbon (R2C)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Radiance2Carbon (R2C) is a QGIS Processing plugin that estimates carbon emissions from multi-temporal Nighttime Lights (NTL) rasters. The algorithm supports several empirical conversion models (Elvidge 2009, Shi 2016, Power Law, and Custom Linear) with automatic or manual threshold filtering to isolate significant illuminated areas. Outputs include CSV reports (carbon estimates and NTL statistics) and PNG visualizations (trend plots, comparison grids, and per-year distributions).
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin provides a straightforward way to transform Nighttime Lights insights into spatially explicit carbon emission indicators. It is suitable for urban sustainability studies, spatial economics, and monitoring of energy-related development patterns using satellite data such as VIIRS or DMSP-OLS. The tool supports batch processing, CRS-safe boundary overlays, and automatic year parsing from raster filenames. Developed by Firman Afrianto and Adipandang Yudono.
pyqgis_plugin.tags: spatial analysis,emission,urban planning,climate,ntl,nighttime lights,power law,carbon,urban sustainability

pyqgis_plugin.about: Plugin for calculating image (raster) index (various indices) based on RGB images. Minimal data set for testing can be found in GitHub repository which is homepage of this plugin in folder: RGB_Index_Calculator-sample. In the same folder shape file is available for testing calculated raster with: NDVI to Variable Nitrogen Application Map plugin.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Meta Mobility Analyzer
pyqgis_plugin.description: Meta Mobility Analyzer is a QGIS Processing plugin for analyzing Meta “Data for Good” mobility datasets (Movement Distribution). It reads daily CSV files, joins them with administrative boundaries, converts distance-share categories into spatial layers, and generates rich analytical outputs including daily summaries, monthly averages, per-category charts, heatmaps, boxplots, and spatial hotspot visualizations. The plugin also supports synthetic Origin–Destination (OD) matrix generation using a calibrated gravity model consistent with Meta distance-share categories (p0, p0_10, p10_100, p100p).
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin provides a complete workflow to process and visualize Meta mobility data for spatial planning, transport analysis, and regional mobility studies. It transforms raw distance-category shares into geospatial insights, structured visual summaries, and optional synthetic OD flows. The plugin supports three output modes: daily SHP files, monthly GeoPackage with one layer per day, and monthly GeoPackage containing only monthly_avg for a true monthly-only summary. It also reports main outputs through clickable links in the QGIS log. Developed by Firman Afrianto and Maya Safira.
pyqgis_plugin.tags: spatial analysis,transportation,urban planning,mobility,gravity model,data for good,big data,meta,origin destination,movement maps

pyqgis_plugin.about: Create Grid is a QGIS plugin that allows users to generate a grid of polygons within a selected polygon layer. Useful for spatial analysis, sampling, or dividing areas into manageable units.

pyqgis_plugin.name: LayoutZoomPlugin
pyqgis_plugin.description: A powerful QGIS plugin for creating and editing map layouts with specific scale and position.
pyqgis_plugin.about: A QGIS plugin providing tools to create new layouts from templates and edit existing layouts by modifying map item scales and positions.

pyqgis_plugin.name: TfC Tools
pyqgis_plugin.description: A suite of tools by Transport for Cairo (TfC)
pyqgis_plugin.about: TfC Tools is a QGIS plugin suite developed by Transport for Cairo (TfC) to streamline and standardise transport data processing workflows. The suite provides user-friendly interfaces for common analytical tasks used in TfC’s research and transport data management projects. TfC Tools currently includes several tools organised into two groups: 1. RouteLab Tools: tools that migrate field survey data from TfC’s RouteLab database into standardised tables, either in GeoPackage format or in a PostGIS Spatial Data Infrastructure (SDI). a. Export RouteLab to GeoPackage b. Export SDI (PostGIS) to GeoPackage c. RL2SDI (RouteLab to SDI Migration) 2. GIS Tools: tools for transport network analysis, GTFS generation, and transport metrics. a. GIS2GTFS – converts GIS data into GTFS. b. Refresh SDI derived layers – after manual GIS edits c. Trip and Route Revenue Estimator d. Vehicle and Passenger Flow Estimator User Guide (PDF): https://github.com/transportforcairo/tfc_tools/blob/main/tfc_tools_user_guide.pdf

pyqgis_plugin.name: AGS Tools

pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin parses an AGS4 file and creates a geopackage or SQlite database from it. AGS4 files can be validated using the British Geological Survey AGSAPI. Results/data returned by the API are subject to the API’s terms (Open Government Licence v3.0). Internet connection required.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Parking Space Potential
pyqgis_plugin.description: A combination of QGIS Tools to analyze the location and capacity of public parking garages and helps to identify street side parking which could be shifted into them.
pyqgis_plugin.about: *TEST*This plugin analyzes the location and capacity of public parking garages and helps to identify street side parking which could be shifted into them. There are three necessary input layers: A layer containing the parking garages [point], a layer containing street side parking [polygon] and a network of walkable links [lines]. As a result, two output layers are generated. One contains all the shiftable street side parking including where they can be shifted to and the distance. The other one contains all selected parking garages including the number of street side parking shiftable into them and their new utilization rates.

pyqgis_plugin.name: GeoBasis_Loader
pyqgis_plugin.description: Einfaches Finden und Einfügen ausgewählter freier Geodienste // Easy finding and insertion of selected free geoservices
pyqgis_plugin.about:
(04.06.2026, v2.1.1) Das Plugin vereinfacht das Finden und Einfügen ausgewählter WMS-, WMTS-, WFS-, WCS-, und VectorTiles-Dienste aus den Open Data Portalen der Landesvermessungsämter sowie von Hintergrundkarten (OSM, Basemap.de) zum aktuellen View. Ziel ist es, eine deutschlandweite Sammlung der GeoBasisdaten mit aktuellen Links anzubieten. Mehr Informationen zum GeoBasis_Loader inkl. Status, Versionshistorie und FAQs auf https://geobasisloader.de/ zu finden.
Hinweis: Die Verfügbarkeit, die Symbolisierung der Inhalte sowie die Sichtbarkeit nach Maßstäben hängen ausschließlich vom Datenanbieter ab. Es gelten die vom Anbieter beschriebenen Nutzungsbedingungen. Bei einigen Themen wird die Sichtbarkeit nach Maßstäben zusätzlich über das Plugin eingestellt und kann bei Bedarf mit QGIS-Bordmitteln geändert werden. Die vom Diensteanbieter festgelegten Maßstabsgrenzen sind davon unbetroffen. Die in diesem Plugin genutzten Links (URLs) auf die Dienste der Anbieter werden mit größtmöglicher Sorgfalt recherchiert und implementiert. Fehler im Bearbeitungsvorgang sind dennoch nicht auszuschließen. Hinweise und Korrekturen senden Sie bitte an news@geoobserver.de?subject=GeoBasis_Loader_Input Eine Haftung für die Verfügbarkeit, Richtigkeit, Vollständigkeit und Aktualität dieser Links kann trotz sorgfältiger Prüfung nicht übernommen werden. Das gilt auch für eventuelle Schäden oder Konsequenzen, die durch die direkte oder indirekte Nutzung der angebotenen Inhalte entstehen.
--------------------------------------
The plugin makes it easier to find and insert selected WMS-, WMTS-, WFS-, WCS-, and VectorTiles services from the open data portals of the state surveying offices and background maps (OSM, Basemap.de) for the current view. The aim is to provide a Germany-wide collection of geodata with up-to-date links. More information about GeoBasis_Loader incl. status, version history and FAQs on https://geobasisloader.de/
Note: The availability, the symbolisation of the content and the visibility according to standards depend exclusively on the data provider. The terms of use described by the provider apply. For some themes, the visibility by scale is also set via the plugin and can be changed using QGIS on-board resources if required. The scale limits set by the service provider are not affected by this. The links (URLs) to the providers' services used in this plugin are researched and implemented with the greatest possible care. However, errors in the editing process cannot be ruled out. Please send any comments and corrections to news@geoobserver.de?subject=GeoBasis_Loader_Input Despite careful checking, no liability can be accepted for the availability, accuracy, completeness and topicality of these links. This also applies to any damage or consequences arising from the direct or indirect use of the content provided.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Open Geodata Browser
pyqgis_plugin.description: Browse and download satellite imagery from STAC-compliant catalogs (Planetary Computer, AWS Earth Search, custom endpoints). Part of MAS Raster Processing tools.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Open Geodata Browser is a powerful QGIS plugin for accessing satellite imagery from leading STAC data providers. Seamlessly search, filter, and load Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs and other geospatial data directly into QGIS with advanced spatial-temporal filtering and batch download capabilities.
Go to the "Home Page" for more details and the Guide.
INSTALL DEPENDENCY: ====================== Plugins > Python Console Copy & Paste: from pip._internal.main import main as pip_main pip_main(['install', '--user', '--upgrade', 'open-geodata-api']) Restart QGIS
Method: Terminal or Commandline tool (Other OS) ================================================== Open the terminal or Commandline Go to the QGIS Binary Path (ls to find Python or PIP executable) Run pip install open-geodata-api
QUICK START: ============ 1. Open: Raster > Open Geodata Browser 2. Select STAC provider 3. Search Items (Filters: Date, Cloud Cover) 4. Interactive Results: - Sort columns by clicking headers - Double-click item to Zoom - Multi-select (Ctrl/Shift) to view multiple footprints - Right-click for "Hide/Show Footprint" 5. Download or Load Assets directly
FEATURES: ========= Multi-provider STAC access | Advanced spatial-temporal search | Batch download | Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs | Auto-load to project | Interactive map | Custom STAC endpoints
REQUIREMENTS: ============= QGIS 3.28+ | Python 3.9+ | Internet | 20MB disk | 2GB RAM

This plugin converts Slovak cadastral GML files (Register C and Register E) to GeoPackage (GPKG) or DXF format. pyqgis_plugin.name: BeachBall

pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin read the strike, dip, and rake information and build the corresponding beachball for representing the focal mechanisms. Obspy module is used for producing the SVGs. Images are coloured according to the kinematics, following the classification of Zoback (1992). Colors can be changed from the UI. The plugin also add P-T-B attitudes and SHmax azimuth in the attribute table. Percentage of DC, CLVD, ISO can be added as fields for the representation.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Camera2geo
pyqgis_plugin.description: Camera to geographic space image conversion
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Camera2Geo converts raw drone or camera images into georeferenced GeoTIFFs via image metadata and a camera model. This can be helpful to quickly view individual aerial images in GIS software, label image features in geographic space, and view images in full resolution rather than in orthomosaic resolution. The core functionality is built from Drone-Footprints but extended with additional features and an improved interface via a Python library, QGIS plugin, and CLI.

Compatible with QGIS 3.x, Qt5/Qt6.\n\nQGIS用の地図検索システム。地番・所有者名・属性検索に対応し、結果はレイヤごとにタブ表示・ページング・表示フィールド選択が可能。タブごとの設定編集UI、マップテーマ切替（selectTheme）、追加表示モード（既存表示に重ねて検索結果を表示）を搭載。QGIS 3.x/Qt5/Qt6対応。

pyqgis_plugin.name: SPHY
pyqgis_plugin.description: A QGIS plugin for preprocessing input data and running simulations for the Spatial Processes in Hydrology (SPHY) model.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin provides a preprocessing and model simulation environment for the Spatial Processes in Hydrology (SPHY) model within QGIS. It allows users to prepare input datasets, configure model parameters, run hydrological simulations, and visualize outputs through a graphical interface. The SPHY QGIS plugin integrates all essential steps of model setup including catchment delineation, parameterization, forcing data preparation, and a simulation environment to run the model and analyse and export results. Note that not all core functionalities of SPHY are available in the QGIS plugin. The full version is available on GitHub (https://github.com/FutureWater/SphyPlugin)

pyqgis_plugin.name: CommonChart
pyqgis_plugin.description: A basic plugin giving access to simplly built data charts and dashboards. Charts calculation is based on building and quering a viritual layer summing and grouping data to show visually. Data selected by user is shown on a side dock and can be dragged to place on screen like every other QGiS pannel. Numerous dashboards can be generated and arranged to create a full analyzing and monitoring display.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
For visual instructions or beta version visit here - github.com/ErezSarig/CommonDashboard/
Plugin under the hood and limitations explained: - Charts calculations are done using qgis's virtual layers. Virtual layers are constructed with SQL which makes them quite fast. Unfortunately this makes any Qgs Expressions or virtual field invisible, since the virtual layers query the source of the layer directly. For some reason, at the moment, that goes for Temporary layers as well (Memory based). - Coloring of the charts derive it's schemes from the layer's category renderer or from project's colors settings. For the moment no more options are available. Based on layer's styling if it's categoriesed. Category's symbol will only work for fill symbols (patterns, dot and gradients fill included). For now fill is created using tiles of 60x60 pixels. Depending on the symbolgy's inner patterns this can sometimes cause a visible unwanted grid shaped pattern. Random assignment of colors derived from project's colors settings. Using project colors limits the number of shown categories to the number of given colors. all other categories will be summed together to a new 'All others' category. Charts are drawn from largest parts to the smallest ones so that colors aren't always assigned to the same categories.
Improvements on next updates: - Common chart menu to enable easy inserting of color schemes and general css and filters whithin qgis - QgsFunction for creating CommonCharts on MapTips and layouts - Hopefully migration to Qt6 on QGiS new coming V4.0 will open up new options for advanced svg drawing. This includes inserting CSS and dynamic interaction with elements of the chart in qgis without exporting.
Write me for any bugs or suggestions

pyqgis_plugin.name: LinkToGoogleMaps
pyqgis_plugin.description: Generate a Google Maps or Street View link from any spot on your QGIS map—copy or open the location instantly with one click, always using WGS84 coordinates.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Create shareable Google Maps and Street View links directly from QGIS. It converts any clicked map point to WGS84 and builds the URL for you. Key features: - One click to copy the link or open it in your browser - Choose Google Maps or Street View as the default action - Automatic reprojection to WGS84 from any layer CRS - Configurable zoom level for Maps and Street View - Toolbar button remembers your last choice - Address search: from the dropdown menu, search by address (Nominatim) to center the map on a place Perfect for quickly sharing precise locations or opening field navigation. Translations: English (default), Italian (it), and Catalan (ca).

pyqgis_plugin.name: OBM Connect
pyqgis_plugin.description: Plugin for connecting to OpenBioMaps and loading spatial layers.
pyqgis_plugin.about: <b>OBM Connect</b> is a QGIS plugin designed to allow users to seamlessly connect to the OpenBioMaps database from within the QGIS environment.<br><br>Its main functionalities include:<ul><li><b>User Authentication:</b> Enables users to log in directly to their OpenBioMaps account.</li> <li><b>Spatial Data Access:</b> Allows authenticated users to conveniently browse, select, and load spatial layers and datasets from OpenBioMaps into QGIS.</li> <li><b>Integrated Workflow:</b> Streamlines data-import workflows for biodiversity, ecological, and environmental projects by providing direct access to official OpenBioMaps repositories.</li></ul>This plugin is ideal for researchers, ecologists, and GIS specialists who regularly work with biodiversity and environmental spatial data, ensuring efficient access to up-to-date datasets while maintaining secure credential management.

pyqgis_plugin.name: EV Charging Station Location Estimator
pyqgis_plugin.description: Estimates possible locations for EV Charging Stations given relevant data.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Estimates optimal points for new Electric Vehicle charging station locations given relevant datasets.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Gestion parcelles forestières
pyqgis_plugin.description: Gestion de parcelles forestières, travaux, traitements, type essences arbres. Ce plugin permet la gestion complète de vos parcelles.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Ce plugin vous permet de gérer vos parcelles forestières, le type d'essences, les travaux et traitements faits ou en prévision, les coordonnées de vos voisins et une analyse statistique simple de vos parcelles. Un code couleur évolutif permet de différencier le type de plantations. Une configuration est nécessaire pour créer les champs et les codes couleurs dans votre table attributaire nécessaires au fonctionnement du plugin. Pour que celui-ci fonctionne il faut tout d'abord installer une couche cadastrale et s'assurer qu'elle comporte bien les champs : id, section, numéro et contenance. Le plugin la convertira au format Geopackage automatiquement. Lire le fichier d'aide LIRE AVANT. Le fichier d'aide est disponible en Français pour les francophones et en Anglais pour toutes les autres langues automatiquement. Compatibilité de la configuration du plugin avec les pays suivants : Luxembourg, Belgique, Suisse, Sénégal, Côte d’Ivoire, Bénin, Burkina Faso, Togo, Mali, Niger. Version compatible Qgis3 Qt5 et Qgis4 Qt6. Merci de vos retours. This plugin allows you to manage your forest plots, the type of tree species, the work and treatments carried out or planned, the contact details of your neighbors and a simple statistical analysis of your plots. Thanks to Pascal O. for his corrections for 1.5.6 . The help file is automatically available in French for French speakers and in English for all other languages.

pyqgis_plugin.description: "This plugin allows you to search and replace text in all text elements of QGIS layouts."

pyqgis_plugin.name: TopoDrain
pyqgis_plugin.description: A QGIS plugin for planning surface drainage water management like Keyline-Design.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
It automates the extraction of main valleys and ridges, creates off-contour line and supports creating Keyline Designs and other water-retention planning measures. The tool can also be used for other tasks, such as planning the location and alignment of paths and roads. DISCLAIMER: Influencing surface runoff on land is complex and requires significant expertise. This tool is intended as an aid for users with experience in land surface water management.
DOCUMENTATION: Detailed INSTALLATION MANUAL and TUTORIAL GUIDES are available on the project homepage: https://github.com/wickit7/topo-drain-plugin
Core algorithms leverage WhiteboxTools (Lindsay, 2017–2020; see https://github.com/jblindsay/whitebox-tools). So make shure you have installed and configured the plugin "WhiteboxTools for QGIS"! - Installation video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xJXDBsNbcTg
This plugin requires several Python packages (numpy, shapely, pandas, geopandas, scipy). These packages are widely used in geospatial data processing, but may not all are included in default QGIS installations (pandas, geopandas, and scipy). If a package is missing, follow the installation instructions below: - Windows, QGIS installed with OSGeo4W: https://landscapearchaeology.org/2018/installing-python-packages-in-qgis-3-for-windows/ - macOS (terminal): https://gis.stackexchange.com/questions/351280/installing-python-modules-for-qgis-3-on-mac See on github site for more informations! -> https://github.com/wickit7/topo-drain-plugin

pyqgis_plugin.name: WZ Workflow
pyqgis_plugin.description: Comprehensive tool for Polish urban planning analysis (Building Permit Conditions - Warunki Zabudowy)
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Advanced QGIS plugin for automated urban planning analysis in Poland (Warunki Zabudowy - WZ).
Features: • 14-step automated workflow for building permit analysis • Deep-learning (CNN) roof-shape classification • Random Forest classification of biologically active surface (PBC) from LiDAR • LiDAR point cloud processing, robust on very large clouds • Cadastral data integration (ULDK/BDOT) • Automated Word report generation • Urban planning indicators (WPZ, WIZ, WPBC)
ML models (~218 MB) are downloaded automatically on first use from GitHub Releases.
---
Kompleksowe narzędzie do automatycznej analizy warunków zabudowy w Polsce. Automatyzuje 14-stopniowy proces analizy urbanistycznej z wykorzystaniem uczenia maszynowego (klasyfikacja kształtu dachów siecią CNN, klasyfikacja powierzchni biologicznie czynnej lasem losowym na podstawie danych LiDAR). Modele ML (~218 MB) są pobierane automatycznie przy pierwszym uruchomieniu z GitHub Releases.
